title: Lee Chang Dong Directs New Film Possible Love
excerpt: Director Lee Chang Dong explores class and labor themes in his seventh feature film, Possible Love, inspired by real events from 2009.
body_html:
Renowned director Lee Chang Dong has created his seventh feature film, titled Possible Love. The movie draws inspiration from real events that occurred in 2009, following a major Korean conglomerate's decision to fire a third of its workforce, equating to 2,600 employees. Following these massive layoffs, many of the affected staff members died by suicide.

The upcoming film continues the director's established tradition of engaging deeply with societal themes concerning class and labor.
